title: Change the class on an individual contractor licence
summary: Learn how to add or change a class on your individual contractor licence if you gain further qualifications.
intro:
An individual contractor licence allows you to work in a particular class based on your qualifications.

If you gain further qualifications that allow you to work in additional classes, you can add or change a class on your individual contractor licence. You can do this at a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: You must gain further qualifications that allow you to work in additional classes.
what_you_need: The required PDF forms (e.g., Application Form - Individual – PDF)
Documentation that validates the change of class
Certificate of eligibility to obtain insurance (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and provide the information together with your payment.

more_info.text: You need a medical gas licence to do any medical gas work in NSW, regardless of the work cost or whether it's residential, commercial or industrial.

faqs.q: How can I change or add a class to my individual contractor licence?
faqs.a: You can add or change a class on your individual contractor licence at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What do I need to change my licence class?
faqs.a: You need the required PDF forms, proof of identity, a passport size photograph, documentation validating the class change, your referee's statement (if applicable), a certificate of eligibility to obtain insurance (if applicable), and your fee payment.
